# LEGG Surfacing Ltd

> LEGG Surfacing Ltd is a specialist surfacing and groundwork contractor based at Unit 229B, Jurby Industrial Estate, Isle of Man (IM7 3BD). We provide resin bound surfacing, tarmac driveways, road and lane surfacing, micro asphalt treatments, groundworks and a range of related surfacing and landscaping services for residential, commercial and infrastructure customers across the Isle of Man.

LEGG Surfacing Ltd is a VUBA Certified Installer, giving access to the full VUBA resin bound surfacing product range for Isle of Man projects.

## Contact

- Phone: +44 7624 326454
- Email: info@leggsurfacing.im
- Address: Unit 229B, Jurby Industrial Estate, IM7 3BD, Isle of Man
- Website: https://leggsurfacing.im
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/leggsurfacing

## Service area

Douglas, Peel, Ramsey, Castletown, Port Erin, Onchan, Port St Mary, Laxey, and the surrounding Isle of Man.

## Services

- [Resin Bound Surfacing](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/resin-bound-surfacing): VUBA accredited resin bound surfacing for driveways, paths and patios, with a choice of colours and aggregates.
- [Tarmac Driveways](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/tarmac-driveways): Tarmac driveway installation and resurfacing for domestic and commercial properties.
- [Road & Lane Surfacing](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/road-lane-surfacing): Private road, access lane and highway access surfacing built for sustained vehicle use.
- [Micro Asphalt](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/micro-asphalt): Micro asphalt surface treatment for roads, lanes and car parks.
- [Drainage & Groundworks](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/groundworks): Drainage, excavation and groundwork, available as part of a surfacing project or as a standalone enquiry.
- [Line Marking](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/line-marking): Car park, road and sports surface line marking.
- [Pattern Imprinted Concrete](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/pattern-imprinted-concrete): Decorative, durable concrete surfacing for driveways and patios.
- [Surface Dressing](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/surface-dressing): Surface treatment to restore skid resistance and weatherproof roads.
- [Playground Safety Rubber Surfacing](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/playground-safety-surfacing): Impact-absorbing rubber surfacing for playgrounds and play areas.
- [Resin-Bonded and High-Friction Surfacing](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/resin-bonded-high-friction-surfacing): Textured, skid-resistant surfacing for domestic driveways, paths, roads and junctions.
- [Block Paving](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/block-paving): Block paving driveways and patios in a range of styles and patterns.
- [Porcelain Paving](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/porcelain-paving): Porcelain paving for patios and outdoor spaces.
- [Concrete Driveways](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/concrete-driveways): Plain and brushed concrete driveways and hardstanding.
- [Driveway Lighting](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/driveway-lighting): Illuminated driveway edging and lighting installed alongside a new driveway.
- [Fencing](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/fencing): Fencing installation from our dedicated landscaping team.
- [Artificial Grass Installation](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/artificial-grass-installation): Low-maintenance artificial grass from our landscaping team.
- [General Landscaping Services](https://leggsurfacing.im/services/landscaping): General landscaping, often completed alongside groundwork and surfacing projects.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All quotations are free and no-obligation; a site visit is typically arranged before a detailed quote is given.
- Prices are not published on the site as they depend on site-specific assessment; direct users to the contact page for a quotation rather than estimating a price.
- LEGG Surfacing Ltd serves the Isle of Man only.
- leggsurfacing.co.uk is an old, unrelated domain no longer used by this business; the current website is leggsurfacing.im.
